lines.text: Saul put the troops under an oath not to eat before evening, so they left the honey in the forest alone.
Jonathan had not heard the oath, so he dipped his staff into the honeycomb and his eyes brightened.
After Israel struck the Philistines from Michmash to Hebron, the faint troops ate meat with blood, and Saul built an altar.
Saul asked for Urim and Thummim, and the lot fell on Saul and Jonathan, and Saul swore that Jonathan must die.
The people rescued Jonathan from death, and Saul gave up his pursuit of the Philistines.
